name: BN5's Surrounded battle, and the same field in BN6's engine
result: In romlab, the board's record getter 0x08008EEA patched in the loaded copy to hand out record 24: the field blue, red, blue two columns each, MegaMan at column 3, Lan's "Surrounded! Press L or R Button to turn around!", L turning MegaMan, the Mettaur on the left striking right, TURN 1 START!, the Custom screen opening at a full gauge. In BN6 (the foes step's sides@33): the same field, the left Mettaur facing MegaMan, L turning him, his buster hitting it; on seed 1's act 2 board a dark panel faced from 25,29: dark level 3, sides 33.
meaning: BN6 kept BN5's Surrounded code whole; a liberation battle needs only its record's +6 and its foes set out as BN5's records set theirs.
